about: What the house asks of its backend: the server's /api/home/*, GET /api/settings and the weather of GET /api/office, as the server answers them (Server.MCP.OperatorAPI docs, Server.Home). `soak_contract.gd` (section `contract`) runs every case against backend_local.gd on a fixed clock (2026-11-18 14:00), cases in order on one fresh list, `as` keeping the answer's id for later `{name}` in a path. A case's `code` and `error` are the server's; a 200 answer must fit `shape`. A case with `gap` is where the local backend answers otherwise: the soak holds it to that, so fixing the gap fails the case until `gap` is deleted, and a gap that is not true fails too. `needs` of a gap: none, network, secret or llm; `size` S, M or L. Shape language: a type name (int num str bool null any obj), `a|b` a union, `@Name` a type below, `[shape]` a list of them, an object lists its keys (every one present, `key?` optional, no extras); `{"$or": [..]}` a union of shapes.

status-forecast.what: GET /api/home has no forecast: the server sends up to three days of the weather (Server.Office.Weather.forecast, wttr.in)

status-meetings.what: GET /api/home has no meetings: today's and tomorrow's, cleaned, from the calendars the server reads (Server.Home.Day)

status-money.what: GET /api/home has no money (the server's is null with the bank source off, a summary of the checking accounts with it on)

meetings-range.what: GET /api/home/meetings answers [] for anything, where the server validates from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, from not after to, at most 62 days: 400) and answers the meetings on each date

proposals.what: POST /api/home/proposals/:id/take and /dismiss are 404 locally and `proposals` is always []; the server's come from sources (Server.Home.Sources: mail, calendar, bank)

money-routes.what: GET /api/home/money/forecast, POST /api/home/money/notices/seen and POST /api/home/money/ask are 404 locally; the server answers from the stored bank data (forecast null when there is none) and a model phrases the ask

pets.what: GET /api/home/pets answers {} locally (the house uses its own voices.gd lines); the server answers the model-written lines by pet then occasion

say-reader.what: POST /api/home {text}: the server reads the line with a model (Server.Home.Inbox.keep) and answers its words; the local backend reads with reader_rules.gd (or the claude helper when set) and words the reply itself

office-weather.what: GET /api/office's `weather` ({kind, temp_c, desc} | null) has no local route: the house reads wttr.in itself (wttr.gd) when `weather` is on
